title: Risk-Adjusted Harm Scoring for Automated Red Teaming for LLMs in Financial Services
abstract: arXiv:2603.10807v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing LLM safety evaluations rely on binary attack-success rates and domain-agnostic taxonomies, leaving regulated Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) deployments exposed to failures elicited through legally or professionally plausible framing. We introduce RAHS (Risk-Adjusted Harm Score), a risk-sensitive metric jointly capturing disclosure severity, disclaimer mitigation, and inter-judge agreement, and FinRedTeamBench, a 989-prompt benchmark spanning seven BFSI risk areas and 34 sub-categories mapped to regulatory frameworks. Evaluation uses an ensemble of three heterogeneous LLM judges, validated against human experts, and an adaptive multi-turn red-teaming pipeline. On nine open-weight models, RAHS preserves separation under near-ceiling ASR, ranking is stable under hyperparameter sweeps, and multi-turn pressure drives not only more jailbreaks but more operationally severe disclosures, exposing failure mode

translated_title: 面向金融服务中大语言模型自动化红队测试的风险调整危害评分
translated_abstract: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）安全评估依赖于二元攻击成功率和与领域无关的分类体系，使得受监管的银行、金融服务和保险（BFSI）领域的部署容易受到通过法律或专业上看似合理的表述所诱发的故障影响。我们提出了RAHS（风险调整危害评分），这是一个风险敏感的指标，联合捕捉披露严重性、免责声明的缓解作用以及评判者之间的一致性；同时提出了FinRedTeamBench，这是一个包含989个提示的基准测试，涵盖七个BFSI风险领域和34个子类别，并映射到相应的监管框架。评估采用三个异构LLM评判者组成的集成方法，并经过人类专家验证，同时配合一个自适应多轮红队测试流水线。在九个开源权重模型上，RAHS在攻击成功率接近饱和的情况下仍能保持区分度，其排名在超参数扫描下保持稳定，且多轮压力测试不仅引发了更多越狱行为，还导致了更具运营严重性的信息泄露，暴露出故障模式。
tldr: 该论文提出了风险调整危害评分（RAHS）指标和FinRedTeamBench基准，通过联合捕捉披露严重性、免责声明缓解作用和评判者一致性，为受监管的金融服务领域中的大语言模型提供了风险敏感的自动化红队测试安全评估方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RAHS (Risk-Adjusted Harm Score) and FinRedTeamBench, a risk-sensitive metric and 989-prompt benchmark that jointly capture disclosure severity, disclaimer mitigation, and inter-judge agreement, enabling risk-aware automated red-teaming safety evaluation of LLMs in regulated financial services.
